name: fuller-shelf
description: FULLER-shelf: an explicit, optional trial, never the default (fuller stays the default). Every FULLER-v1 control is copied verbatim from profiles/fuller.json; the only addition is one boost-only low shelf at 100 Hz, +1.5 dB, Q 0.7 (lowshelf t=q), the tone_ab trial values, under the 2026-10-07 operator ruling (bounded 80-160 Hz, 0 to +2 dB, Q 0.5-0.707; never a cut or notch near the ~32 Hz fundamental). The shelf runs before the peaking EQ, compression and loudnorm, unlike the tone_ab trial, which was applied after delivery loudness normalization, so the tone_ab real-take delta does not transfer to this chain. It is not covered by the FULLER listening acceptance: operator_review_status unreviewed_trial, listening_acceptance not_performed. Preference requires operator listening at matched level against fuller. Reversible procedurally: re-render the unchanged source with profile fuller. A reviewed per-take capture interval is required input and is never baked in. No high-pass, low cut, hum notch or 2.2 kHz boost; preserve_low_fundamental_hz 32. No claim of 32 Hz restoration, recreation of an uncaptured fundamental, room or amp tone, isolated fan removal, analysis accuracy or suitability on other takes.
